body.x: enhans, led by CEO Lee Seung-hyun, participated in the ‘CES Unveiled’ global media event on January 7th, before the official launch of CES 2024 in Las Vegas. Founded in 2021, ENHANCE is an AI commerce solution startup specializing in maintaining and managing global product information in real-time and time-sequenced. ENHANCE is developing a model where AI transcends simple monitoring to act as an ‘AI Shopping Assistant.’
The company has filed for 20 patents on big data and automation in the US and South Korea. It provides a monthly subscription-based SaaS commerce operating solution to major domestic companies.
enhans showcased its flagship product and AI agent service, ‘Enstead,’ at CES Unveiled 2024, a pre-CES event targeting global media to showcase participating companies’ products and technologies.

Enstead, by enhans, is centered around a ‘Dynamic Pricing Monitoring’ system, offering customers optimal pricing information. It considers real-time market trends, discount benefits, shipping schedules, supply and demand changes, and customer reviews to present the best prices, thus finely tuning customers’ purchasing strategies.

body.cap: Lee Seung-hyun, enhans’s CEO, interacts with international media at CES Unveiled. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: A key feature developed by ENHANCE, the ‘Action Transformer,’ facilitates smooth interactions between AI agents and customers through natural language. This feature aims to provide a new interactive shopping experience that actively responds to customers, along with a simplified UX (User Experience) based on ‘Voice Interaction,’ delivering a personalized commerce experience.

CEO Lee Seung-hyun said, “Our AI agent services, including Enstead, are all designed with the global market in mind. There was no reason not to participate in Unveiled, where global media can meet each tech company’s products.” He added that the early exposure of their services to journalists, influencers, and YouTubers could lead to solid promotional effects before commercialization and help build a network for future use.

The Consumer Technology Association (CTA), host of CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, provides a platform in Las Vegas each January to showcase global consumer electronics trends. AVING News, covering CES for 18 consecutive years, has been reporting CES news worldwide since 2006, highlighting products, companies, and technologies with the ‘BEST OF CES’ and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA’ awards programs. They also discuss issues in the field from the CES scene through ‘AVING LIVE.’

The CES 2024 Seoul pavilion, operating on its most enormous scale since Seoul’s first CES participation in 2020, is a joint effort of 13 organizations, including SBA, Seoul Bio Hub, Campus Town, AI Yangjae Hub, Gwanak District, Yonsei University, Korea University, Chung-Ang University, Sogang University, Kookmin University, Hanyang University, Konkuk University, and Kyung Hee University. This collaborative pavilion marks a significant step in Seoul’s ambition to become a startup hub, and among its participating companies, 17 received innovation awards, evidencing their excellence. The pavilion also includes 85 supporters in a significant collaboration between companies, institutions, and industry-academia cooperation.
